court_name: Superior Court of California, County of San Bernardino
case_search_note: 'Criminal/Traffic Court Case Information Online' (linked from the court's Criminal division page). Online data is not the official record. Felony/misdemeanor bail schedule (eff. 1/1/26) is posted on the Criminal page.

courthouses.name: San Bernardino Justice Center — Criminal Division
courthouses.note: Cases served: Criminal. Time-critical requests email: TimecriticalrequestsSBJC@sb-court.org. Civil Division is in the same building ((909) 708-8678).

courthouses.name: Victorville District
courthouses.hours: Building hours Mon–Fri from 8:00 a.m. (page shows a typo for closing time); Victorville juvenile delinquency page lists clerk's office 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m., public phone 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Cases served: Criminal, Probate, Juvenile. Criminal email: CourtsVictorvilleCriminal@sb-court.org.

courthouses.name: Joshua Tree District (Morongo Basin)
courthouses.note: Cases served: Civil, Criminal, Family Law, Landlord/Tenant, Small Claims, Traffic. Email JoshuaTree@sb-court.org.

courthouses.name: Barstow District
courthouses.note: Cases served: Small Claims, Landlord Tenant, Civil Restraining Orders, Family Law, Child Support, Traffic (traffic line (760) 718-3700). Criminal not listed on the location page, though the Sheriff says in-custody video court assignments include Barstow.

courthouses.name: Fontana District
courthouses.note: Cases served: small claims, landlord/tenant, probate, traffic, civil harassment. Criminal not listed on the location page, though the Sheriff lists Fontana among in-custody video court assignments.

courthouses.name: Needles District
courthouses.note: Cases served: Family Law, Landlord Tenant, Small Claims, Traffic. Not criminal.

courthouses.name: Big Bear District
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office open 1st Wednesday of each month 9:30 a.m.–1:30 p.m. (limited services)
courthouses.note: Traffic, Non-Traffic arraignments and Misdemeanor modifications can be heard at 10:00 a.m. by Remote Video Proceedings — schedule at (760) 974-3020. Most other matters are heard in Barstow.
courthouses.todo: main phone not clearly listed for Big Bear itself

courthouses.name: San Bernardino Juvenile Delinquency
courthouses.note: Juvenile delinquency only. Next to the Central Valley Juvenile Detention and Assessment Center (900 E. Gilbert St.).

courthouses.name: Mental Health Court (ARMC Colton)
courthouses.address: Arrowhead Regional Medical Center, Behavioral Health Building, 400 North Pepper Avenue
courthouses.hours: Court held Tuesday afternoons and Friday mornings; no public access except during hearings
courthouses.note: LPS/involuntary-treatment hearings (writs, LPS conservatorships) — civil mental health, not a criminal court. Office of the Mental Health Counselors (909) 498-2296.

public_defenders.name: SB Public Defender — Central Division
public_defenders.note: Across from the San Bernardino courthouse; handles PD criminal cases from the San Bernardino court.

public_defenders.name: SB Public Defender — Rancho Cucamonga / West Valley Division
public_defenders.note: Handles PD cases from the Foothill/Rancho court.

legal_aid.name: SB Public Defender — Post-Conviction Relief Unit (Clear Your Record)
legal_aid.serves: People with San Bernardino County convictions (apply in your county of residence)
legal_aid.what: PD staff help clear convictions (PC 1203.4/1203.4a dismissals and other relief) and PC 290 relief, via an online application form. The PD also runs 'Mobile Defense' events with free legal help and expungement events around the county.
legal_aid.todo: PCU contact page shows a web form only; no direct phone listed

legal_aid.name: SBSC Self-Help Resource Center
legal_aid.what: Legal information (not advice): court procedures, review of completed forms, referrals. Case types listed: family law, child support, guardianship, landlord-tenant, small claims, CARE Court — criminal not listed.

probation.name: SB Probation — Administrative Office
probation.note: Footer lists 175 W. Fifth St., 4th Floor, phone (909) 387-5874.

SB Probation — Central Juvenile Services

programs.name: What happens in a misdemeanor case
programs.summary: Court's Criminal page explains arrest, arraignment/plea (not guilty, guilty, no contest), pre-trial, and what to bring to court (ID, citation/papers, proof of compliance, payment). Missing court can mean a warrant.

programs.name: Felony/Misdemeanor Bail Schedule
programs.summary: Court posts the countywide bail schedule (effective 1/1/26) and a 'Why is my bail or fine so much?' explainer.

programs.name: Remote Video Proceedings (traffic/non-traffic arraignments)
programs.summary: Some traffic and non-traffic arraignments (e.g., Big Bear) are heard by remote video; schedule by phone.

programs.name: Collaborative Treatment Courts
programs.summary: Court news (May 2024) says SBSC has run collaborative treatment courts for 30 years; the court also holds Shelter Court at Veterans Stand Down events. No current program page (eligibility, departments) was found on the court site.
programs.todo: No adult collaborative court program page found; only a juvenile drug court page exists in the sitemap

programs.name: ARISE Program (Probation)
programs.summary: Probation program listed at 21101 Dale Evans Parkway, Apple Valley 92307, (760) 961-6701.

jails.name: West Valley Detention Center
jails.phone_note: Facility page lists visiting appointments Tue–Sat 8:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Visits for all SB County jails: book one day ahead by calling the Visiting Center (909) 887-0364; visiting days Wed–Sat; arrive 30 minutes early (Sheriff Inmate General Information page).
jails.note: Sheriff: mostly pre-trial inmates; court assignments by remote video for San Bernardino, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga, Chino, Victorville and Barstow courts; Transportation Division moves those who must appear in person.
jails.todo: houses (men/women) not stated; commissary/money deposit page not found on Sheriff site

jails.name: Central Detention Center
jails.phone_note: Visits for all SB County jails: book one day ahead by calling the Visiting Center (909) 887-0364; visiting days Wed–Sat; arrive 30 minutes early (Sheriff Inmate General Information page).
jails.note: Sheriff: primary booking facility for east valley police/sheriff stations; also houses federal (U.S. Marshals) inmates.

jails.name: High Desert Detention Center
jails.phone_note: Facility page lists inmate locator line (909) 708-8371. Visits for all SB County jails: book one day ahead by calling the Visiting Center (909) 887-0364; visiting days Wed–Sat; arrive 30 minutes early (Sheriff Inmate General Information page).
jails.note: Sheriff: Type II facility, housing for over 2,100.

jails.phone_note: Visiting appointments Wed–Sat 9:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m., (909) 887-0364. Mailing: P.O. Box 9490.
jails.note: Sheriff: primary facility for male and female inmates sentenced to county commitments; the Female Facility houses pre-trial and sentenced females.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — verify a bail agent before signing. SB Sheriff: bail agents may only visit when the arrestee, their attorney, an adult immediate family member, or someone with the inmate's written approval requested bail services; agents may not visit to solicit business. Court posts the countywide felony/misdemeanor bail schedule.
